title: Circle (CRCL) Cuts About 5% of Workforce as Q3 Revenue Hits $865M
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Circle (CRCL) Cuts About 5% of Workforce as Q3 Revenue Hits $865M Circle cut about 5% of its workforce and booked a $9.1 million restructuring charge in a quarter where revenue rose 17% to $865 million. This post Circle (CRCL) Cuts About 5% of Workforce as Q3 Revenue Hits $865M first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
